tasks.description: Classify and, only if justified, resolve the password-reset integration-test status mismatch.
tasks.reason: The prior backend suite had 108 tests with one failure: an invalid reset token currently produces HTTP 409 through business-rule handling while the test expects HTTP 400. The intended contract must decide whether this is a valid conflict response or a regression.
tasks.requirements: Preserve the existing uncommitted password-reset implementation and unrelated changes. Trace the reset endpoint, request validation, BusinessRuleException/status mapping, and existing API semantics to determine whether an invalid/expired reset token should be a 400 validation/client error or a 409 business conflict. Do not change production behavior or weaken the test merely to obtain a green suite. If the implementation matches the established contract, update only the incorrect assertion and explain the evidence; if it violates the contract, make the smallest targeted correction and add/update a focused assertion. Before running integration tests that write/delete records, verify the test profile uses an isolated, non-production database without inspecting credentials; otherwise skip the data-writing test and report the blocker. Run focused reset-service/API tests and the backend suite only when safe, reporting all outcomes.
